sentences.en: So, you know, it has a kind of resonant role in the history of the wars of the French and the English.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，它在英法战争史上具有某种共鸣般的重要作用。

sentences.en: And it's very useful because people can cross 12 men abreast there.
sentences.zh: 这里非常实用，因为人们可以在那里12人并肩过河。

sentences.en: It would be a quick crossing.
sentences.zh: 那将会是一次快速的渡河。

sentences.en: And so the French assume that this is where Henry will try and make his crossing.
sentences.zh: 所以法国人认为亨利会试图在这里渡河。

sentences.en: And D'Albray, the constable who'd been in Rouen with the Dauphin, he marches at top speed
sentences.zh: 阿尔布雷，也就是曾与王太子一起在鲁昂的王家统帅，他以最快的速度

sentences.en: to this ford with 6,000 men and they fortify the far bank and block the passage with stakes.
sentences.zh: 率领6000人赶到这个浅滩，他们加固了对岸，并用木桩封锁了通道。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, other contingents, they're fanning out down the length of the Somme and they're
sentences.zh: 与此同时，其他部队正沿索姆河全线散开，他们

sentences.en: demolishing bridges, smashing up causeways, trying to make it very, very difficult for
sentences.zh: 拆毁桥梁，砸毁堤道，千方百计让亨利

sentences.en: Henry to cross the river.
sentences.zh: 渡河变得难上加难。

sentences.en: So that will push him south.
sentences.zh: 这会把他向南逼。

sentences.en: Like if he can't cross, he will have to turn to his right and march up the river Somme, south into the heart of France, try and find a crossing base.
sentences.zh: 就像如果他无法过河，他将不得不向右转，沿索姆河向上游行军，向南进入法国腹地，试图寻找一个过河点。

sentences.en: And of course, he will run out of food and they'll be able to surround him and kill him.
sentences.zh: 当然，他的食物会耗尽，他们就能包围并消灭他。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: And it is a massive problem for Henry because absolutely Blanchetac, this ford near the sea is exactly where he is hoping to cross.
sentences.zh: 这对亨利来说是个巨大无比的问题，因为布朗什塔克，这个靠近大海的浅滩绝对是他期望过河的地方。

sentences.en: And he approaches it and they capture a prisoner.
sentences.zh: 当他走近时，他们俘虏了一名囚犯。

sentences.en: And this prisoner says, you know, your majesty, the far side is fortified.
sentences.zh: 这个囚犯说，陛下，对岸已经被防御加固了。

sentences.en: It's got stakes.
sentences.zh: 那里有木桩。

sentences.en: It's got D'Albray.
sentences.zh: 那里有阿尔布雷。

sentences.en: It's got 6,000 men.
sentences.zh: 那里有6000大军。

sentences.en: You know, you don't want to cross it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你绝对不想从那里过河。

sentences.en: And Henry isn't 100% certain that he believes this.
sentences.zh: 而亨利并不是百分之百确定自己相信这一点。

sentences.en: So he continues to interview the prisoner.
sentences.zh: 所以他继续审问这名俘虏。

sentences.en: And at the end of the interview, he's been convinced.
sentences.zh: 审问结束时，他被说服了。

sentences.en: He thinks, yes, the prisoner is telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 他觉得，是的，俘虏说的是实话。

sentences.en: And so he halts the march.
sentences.zh: 于是他下令停止行军。

sentences.en: He summons his magnates and they have a council of war and they debate for a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 他召集他的贵族们召开军事会议，他们辩论了好几个小时。

sentences.en: And then they decide we can't risk it.
sentences.zh: 然后他们决定我们不能冒这个险。

sentences.en: You know, we'll be slaughtered if they really are there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果他们真的在那儿，我们会被屠杀的。

sentences.en: We've got no choice but to start marching upriver.
sentences.zh: 我们别无选择，只能开始向河的上游行军。

sentences.en: There's no question at that point of turning back to our fleur.
sentences.zh: 当时根本不可能考虑掉头回阿夫勒尔。

sentences.en: No, it's an interesting one.
sentences.zh: 不，这是一个有趣的问题。

sentences.en: They don't.
sentences.zh: 他们没有。

sentences.en: Because I think it would be too great a humiliation.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为那将是太大的屈辱。

sentences.en: So now instead of doing that, they take this mad gamble, really, of saying we're going to turn inland into the heart of France.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他们不那样做，而是冒了一个疯狂的险，真的，声称我们要向内陆进发，直插法国腹地。

sentences.en: Well, I think that's the measure of both Henry's determination not to be humiliated on the stage of France and indeed of Christendom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这既体现了亨利决心不在法国和整个基督教世界的舞台上受辱，也体现了他的决心。

sentences.en: And also his, you know, his inner confidence.
sentences.zh: 还有他的，你知道的，他内心的自信。

sentences.en: This is such Alexander the Great behaviour, I think.
sentences.zh: 这太像亚历山大大帝的行径了，我认为。

sentences.en: As, of course, in Shakespeare's play, the Welsh captain Flewellyn, likewise, compares Henry V to Alexander.
sentences.zh: 正如莎士比亚戏剧中那样，威尔士队长弗鲁艾林同样把亨利五世比作亚历山大。

sentences.en: Well, that's the Welsh blood speaking to you, Tom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是威尔士人在说话，汤姆。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So as you say, this is very, very bad for morale because, you know, Henry's men, they know that they haven't got much food.
sentences.zh: 所以正如你所说，这对士气非常非常不利，因为，你知道的，亨利的人马知道他们没有多少食物。

sentences.en: They're now having to march inland away from Calais and they can't be sure that they're going to find a crossing point.
sentences.zh: 他们现在不得不背离加来向内陆行军，而且他们无法确定是否能找到过河点。

sentences.en: So this is all very, very alarming.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都非常非常令人担忧。

sentences.en: And what's even more unsettling for them as they start to get a bit peckish is that Henry continues to uphold the ordinances of war.
sentences.zh: 而当他们开始觉得有点饿时，更让他们感到不安的是，亨利继续严格执行军事条例。

sentences.en: He is still not going to allow them to plunder and to loot and to strip the cottages and the villages of his French subjects of their food.
sentences.zh: 他仍然不允许他们掠夺、抢劫，也不允许他们剥夺法国子民村庄里的食物。

sentences.en: And to impose this, he instructs that only certain officers can have dealings with the French.
sentences.zh: 为了强制执行这一点，他指示只有特定的军官才能与法国人打交道。

sentences.en: So, in other words, there's going to be a clear chain of communication that he could control.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，将有一条他可以控制的清晰的沟通链。

sentences.en: He's not having people just fanning out.
sentences.zh: 他不会让人们只是四处散开。

sentences.en: And as a marker of his absolute determination to uphold these rules, when one of his soldiers steals a silver fitting from a church, this guy is publicly hanged.
sentences.zh: 作为他坚决执行这些规则的标志，当他的一个士兵从一座教堂偷了一个银制配件时，这家伙被当众绞死了。

sentences.en: And in Shakespeare's play, this is a character called Bardolph, who was one of Henry V's drinking companions.
sentences.zh: 在莎士比亚的戏剧中，这是一个名叫巴多尔夫的角色，他是亨利五世的酒友之一。

sentences.en: One of Falstaff's cronies, yeah.
sentences.zh: 法斯塔夫的死党之一，是的。

sentences.en: Back when he was Prince Hal, yeah.
sentences.zh: 回到他还是哈尔王子的时候，是的。

sentences.en: He was Falstaff's servant.
sentences.zh: 他是法斯塔夫的仆人。

sentences.en: And in the Kenneth Branagh film, he's played by Richard Briars, who is the hero of the good life, who I think you wrote about, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 在肯尼思·布拉纳的电影中，他由理查德·布赖尔斯饰演，他是《美好生活》的主角，我想你写过关于他的文章，对吧？

sentences.en: I have written about the good life.
sentences.zh: 我确实写过关于《美好生活》的文章。

sentences.en: Though for me, Richard Briars' best role was in ever decreasing circles, Tom.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，理查德·布赖尔斯最好的角色是在《渐入佳境》里，汤姆。

sentences.en: You were not wrong.
sentences.zh: 你没有说错。

sentences.en: You were not wrong.
sentences.zh: 你没有说错。

sentences.en: So anyway, so poor Richard Briars gets hanged.
sentences.zh: 总之，可怜的理查德·布赖尔斯被绞死了。

sentences.en: And this is all about upholding discipline.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了维护纪律。

sentences.en: Henry also insists that every English soldier should wear the cross of St. George so that they can be identified.
sentences.zh: 亨利还坚持每个英格兰士兵都佩戴圣乔治十字勋章，以便能够识别他们。

sentences.en: And discipline is very, very strict.
sentences.zh: 而且纪律非常非常严格。

sentences.en: And Dominic, I'm proud.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我感到骄傲。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Proud to say that even the French acknowledge this.
sentences.zh: 骄傲地说，连法国人都承认这一点。

sentences.en: Saw this.
sentences.zh: 看到了这一点。

sentences.en: This brought tears to my eyes, actually.
sentences.zh: 这实际上让我热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wonderful.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So a French chronicler says, Henry always observed proper and honourable practices.
sentences.zh: 所以一位法国编年史家说，亨利总是遵守规范和荣誉行为。

sentences.en: And there's another French chronicler who contrasts the behaviour of the English, who are notorious in France for the brutality of their chevauché.
sentences.zh: 还有另一位法国编年史家将英格兰人的行为与他们进行了对比，英格兰人在法国以其骑兵驰掠的残酷性而闻名。

sentences.en: But they say that this time, no, they behave very well.
sentences.zh: 但他们说这次没有，他们表现得非常好。

sentences.en: And it's the French who behave badly as they're kind of charging across Normandy to try and block off all these crossing points on the Somme.
sentences.zh: 反而是法国人表现糟糕，因为他们正冲过诺曼底，试图封锁索姆河上的所有这些过河点。

sentences.en: And they did nothing, according to this chronicler, save robbing and pillaging towns, monasteries and abbeys and violating women.
sentences.zh: 根据这位编年史家的说法，他们除了抢劫和掠夺城镇、修道院和大修道院以及强暴妇女外，什么也没做。

sentences.en: Plus ça change, Tom.
sentences.zh: 太阳底下无新事，汤姆。

sentences.en: I mean, that basically set the tone for the next 600 years, didn't it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这基本上定下了未来600年的基调，不是吗？

sentences.en: I think the most ringing endorsement of the behaviour of the English on this march is given by Anne Currie, who it's fair to say is not Team Henry V.
sentences.zh: 我认为对英格兰人在这次行军中的行为最响亮的赞誉是由安·柯里给出的，可以说她不是亨利五世的拥趸。

sentences.en: But even she acknowledges that the overall impression is that the English were better disciplined.
sentences.zh: 但连她也承认，总体印象是英格兰人纪律更好。

sentences.en: That's coming from a herald.
sentences.zh: 这是来自一个传令官的说法。

sentences.en: It's coming from a herald.
sentences.zh: 来自一个传令官。

sentences.en: So she'd know.
sentences.zh: 所以她很清楚。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I think all English listeners can feel very proud of that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想所有英国听众都可以为此感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: So hooray for Henry.
sentences.zh: 所以为亨利欢呼。

sentences.en: But of course, none of this helps them cross the Somme and none of this helps them stay well fed.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这些都无助于他们过索姆河，也无助于他们吃饱饭。

sentences.en: And so as they march along the line of the Somme, they're getting more and more depressed.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他们沿着索姆河行军时，他们变得越来越沮丧。

sentences.en: And what adds to their sense of depression is the realisation that they're being shadowed on the other side of the river.
sentences.zh: 加重他们沮丧感的是，他们意识到河对岸有人在尾随他们。

sentences.en: So at this point, they can see the French.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，他们可以看到法国人。

sentences.en: They have a sense of them.
sentences.zh: 他们对他们有所察觉。

sentences.en: Well, they either see them or they, you know, Henry has spies who are bringing in news.
sentences.zh: 嗯，要么他们看到了，要么，你知道的，亨利有间谍在带回消息。

sentences.en: And these spies report that these French armies are being led by D'Albrey and by Boussicot, who are the two greatest soldiers in France.
sentences.zh: 这些间谍报告说，这些法国军队由德·阿尔布雷和布西科统帅，他们是法国最伟大的两名军人。

sentences.en: So, you know, they clearly mean business.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他们显然是来真的。

sentences.en: And so we have a brilliant account of how it felt for them that comes from this chaplain in Henry's train.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们有一份精彩的记录，讲述了亨利随行的一位牧师对他们当时感受的描述。

sentences.en: And he writes, At the time, we thought of nothing else but this, that after the eight days assigned for the march had expired and our provisions had run out,
sentences.zh: 他写道：当时，我们只想到了这一点，那就是在指定的八天行军期限已过、我们的给养耗尽之后，

sentences.en: the enemy craftily hasting on ahead and laying waste the countryside in advance would impose on us, hungry as we should be, a really dire need of food.
sentences.zh: 敌人狡猾地抢先赶路，提前荒芜了乡野，这将使饥肠辘辘的我们面临极其严重的食物短缺。

sentences.en: And at the head of the river, if God did not provide otherwise, would with their great and countless host and the engines of war and devices available to them,
sentences.zh: 如果在上帝没有做别的安排的情况下，在河流的上游，他们凭借庞大而无数的军队以及他们可用的战争机器和装置，

sentences.en: overwhelm us so very few as we were and made faint by great weariness and weak from lack of food.
sentences.zh: 将压倒我们这寥寥无几的人，使我们因极度疲劳而虚弱，因缺乏食物而无力。

sentences.en: So, you know, not a cheery state of play and it comes to seem worse and worse, the deeper and deeper into France they go.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这并不是一种令人愉快的状态，而且他们深入法国腹地越深，情况就显得越糟糕。

sentences.en: So three days go by, four days, five days since their failure to forward the Somme at Blanchetac.
sentences.zh: 于是三天过去了，四天，五天，自从他们在布朗舍塔克未能渡过索姆河以来。

sentences.en: And then finally, at dawn on the 19th of October, at last, the English get the news that they've been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 然后终于在10月19日的黎明，英格兰人终于得到了他们一直在等待的消息。

sentences.en: There's not one ford ahead, there are two.
sentences.zh: 前方不是一个浅滩，而是两个。

sentences.en: And it's unclear how they're discovered, but it's likely that Henry gets told about them by a kind of local who wants, you know, he wants the English off his lands.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚它们是如何被发现的，但很可能是某个当地人把它们告诉了亨利的，他希望，你知道的，他希望英国人离开他的土地。

sentences.en: These fords are going to be perilous to cross because they have to be approached through a marsh.
sentences.zh: 这些浅滩过河时会有危险，因为必须穿过一片沼泽才能接近它们。

sentences.en: And obviously for an army to go through a marsh, that's very vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 显然，对于一支军队来说，穿过沼泽是非常脆弱的。

sentences.en: And the causeways have been smashed up.
sentences.zh: 而且堤道已经被破坏了。

sentences.en: So Boussica had been there earlier and his men had kind of smashed them up.
sentences.zh: 所以布西科之前去过那里，他的人把它们砸坏了。

sentences.en: But it was still possible with difficulty and in a single file.
sentences.zh: 但尽管困难，且只能单行，这仍然是可能的。

sentences.en: But the opposite bank is not guarded.
sentences.zh: 但对岸没有防守。

sentences.en: So if the luck of the English holds, if no French forces come while they're engaged in this operation to cross the Somme, they will be able to get across.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果英格兰人的运气持续，如果在他们进行这次渡过索姆河的行动时没有法军部队前来，他们将能够过去。

sentences.en: Why is it not guarded?
sentences.zh: 为什么没有防守？

sentences.en: Because the French think they've smashed the causeways and therefore...
sentences.zh: 因为法国人认为他们已经砸毁了堤道，所以……

sentences.en: Because the Somme is so long, there are so many potential crossing points.
sentences.zh: 因为索姆河太长了，有那么多潜在的过河点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You know, they're scattered.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们分散了。

sentences.en: So it's absolutely a moment of excruciating danger.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对是一个极其危险的时刻。

sentences.en: And Henry knows this, but he also knows he has no choice.
sentences.zh: 亨利知道这一点，但他也很清楚自己别无选择。

sentences.en: So what happens is he orders some of his archers in the vanguard to go first and they get their bows, they get their quivers, they hold them up over their heads.
sentences.zh: 所以发生的事情是，他命令先锋部队的一些弓箭手先走，他们拿上弓，拿上箭筒，把它们举过头顶。

sentences.en: They don't want their bow strings to get wet.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让弓弦弄湿。

sentences.en: And they cross and then they take up a position on the far bank to protect those who are going to be following them.
sentences.zh: 他们过了河，然后在对岸占据一个位置，以保护将要跟随他们的人。

sentences.en: The men at arms follow and then the horses of the vanguard.
sentences.zh: 重骑兵随后跟进，然后是先锋队的马匹。

sentences.en: So to be clear, of course, most men have not been travelling on horseback.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，当然，大多数人并不是骑马旅行的。

sentences.en: They've been just trudging.
sentences.zh: 他们只是一步步艰难地走着。

sentences.en: Yeah, most people have been riding on horseback.
sentences.zh: 是的，大多数人都是骑马的。

sentences.en: Oh, sorry.
sentences.zh: 哦，抱歉。

sentences.en: They have been.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在骑。

sentences.en: Yeah, there've been enough horses for them to be doing that.
sentences.zh: 是的，有足够的马匹让他们这么做。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so the horses are important because it expedites their speed.
sentences.zh: 因此马匹很重要，因为它们加快了速度。

sentences.en: So once the vanguard is across, you've got the archers, you've got the men at arMs.
sentences.zh: 所以一旦先锋过河，你就有了弓箭手，有了重骑兵。

sentences.en: They are then in a position to hold off an attacking force.
sentences.zh: 他们随后处于能够阻挡进攻部队的位置。

sentences.en: And while they've been crossing, everybody else has been kind of smashing up local settlements, taking the rubble, using it to build up the causeway so that it can then be crossed.
sentences.zh: 当他们在过河时，其他人一直在摧毁当地的定居点，收集瓦砾，用它来修复堤道，以便随后可以通过。

sentences.en: And by one o'clock in the afternoon, so it's taken them the whole morning, the causeways can be negotiated by three men marching abreaSt.
sentences.zh: 到了下午一点，所以他们花了一整个上午的时间，堤道可以供三人并肩行军通过。

sentences.en: And the full scale operation happens and Henry risks dividing up his army.
sentences.zh: 全面行动展开，亨利冒着分散军队的风险。

sentences.en: So the body of men cross one of the causeways, the luggage train with all the arrows and supplies and everything crosses the other.
sentences.zh: 因此，主力部队穿过其中一条堤道，载有所有箭矢、补给品及一切的行李车队穿过另一条。

sentences.en: And they make it across, even though while they're doing it, a squad of French horsemen do ride up and observe them.
sentences.zh: 他们成功过河了，尽管在他们这样做的时候，一队法国骑兵确实骑马过来观察了他们。

sentences.en: But they realise that, you know, they haven't got enough men to attack Henry's force.
sentences.zh: 但他们意识到，你知道的，他们没有足够的人马去攻击亨利的军队。

sentences.en: And so it is an amazing feat to pull this off.
sentences.zh: 所以完成这个壮举真是太惊人了。

sentences.en: And English morale surges correspondingly.
sentences.zh: 英格兰人的士气也随之大涨。

sentences.en: And the chaplain is so excited about it that he thinks the way to Calais is now open.
sentences.zh: 牧师对此感到非常兴奋，他认为通往加来的道路现在已经敞开。

sentences.en: And that the news that the English have made it across in spite of all the French, this will be so demoralising for the French.
sentences.zh: 而且英国人在所有法国人的阻挠下成功过河的消息，将对法国人造成极大的打击。

sentences.en: Their morale will plummet.
sentences.zh: 他们的士气将一落千丈。

sentences.en: And in the words of the chaplain, they will be disinclined to follow after us to do battle.
sentences.zh: 用牧师的话来说，他们将不愿意尾随我们进行战斗。

sentences.en: But unfortunately for him and for the rest of the English, the opposite is actually the case.
sentences.zh: 但对他和其余英国人不幸的是，实际情况恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Because once the English have crossed the Somme, this vast French army, they know that it's no longer their business to kind of fan out along the length of the river.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦英国人渡过了索姆河，这支庞大的法军就知道，他们的任务不再是沿着河流的长度散开。

sentences.en: They need to concentrate and block the path to Calais and engage the English in battle and hopefully wipe them out.
sentences.zh: 他们需要集中兵力，封锁通往加来的道路，并与英国人交战，希望彻底消灭他们。

sentences.en: Because in a way, although the English are across, they've basically walked into, it's not really a trap, but they've walked into the killing ground.
sentences.zh: 因为在某种程度上，尽管英国人已经过河，但他们基本上走进了一个——这其实不是一个陷阱，但他们走进了杀戮地带。

sentences.en: The French army is huge.
sentences.zh: 法军规模庞大。

sentences.en: It's there.
sentences.zh: 它就在那里。

sentences.en: And the English now are tired.
sentences.zh: 而现在的英国人很累。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're hungry.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们饿了。

sentences.en: Yeah, hungry.
sentences.zh: 是的，饿了。

sentences.en: They're famished.
sentences.zh: 他们饿极了。

sentences.en: They're wet.
sentences.zh: 他们湿透了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like a kind of, imagine, you know, a 10-day walking holiday in the Lake District where you're completely loSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就像是一个，想象一下，你知道的，在湖区进行为期10天的步行度假，你彻底迷路了。

sentences.en: It just rains all the time.
sentences.zh: 雨一直下个不停。

sentences.en: You haven't got any food.
sentences.zh: 你没有任何食物。

sentences.en: And then you've got to fight at the end.
sentences.zh: 然后你最后还得打仗。

sentences.en: And then you've got to fight the French.
sentences.zh: 然后你还得跟法国人打仗。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 所以问题是这样的。

sentences.en: The constable is there.
sentences.zh: 康斯太勃尔在那里。

sentences.en: The guy, Alençon de Bruzo, is there.
sentences.zh: 那个家伙，阿朗松·德·布吕佐在那里。

sentences.en: Boussicot.
sentences.zh: 布西科。

sentences.en: The paladin.
sentences.zh: 帕拉丁。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's there.
sentences.zh: 是的，他在那里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What about the Dauphin?
sentences.zh: 太子呢？

sentences.en: Because you said the Dauphin was, dare I say, too fat to fight.
sentences.zh: 因为你曾说过太子，恕我直言，胖得无法打仗。

sentences.en: The Dauphin.
sentences.zh: 太子。

sentences.en: So there's this great council of war where all these various magnates are in attendance.
sentences.zh: 所以举行了一场伟大的军事会议，所有这些显贵都出席了。

sentences.en: It's held on the 19th of October, which, of course, is the same day that the English are crossing the Somme.
sentences.zh: 它于10月19日举行，当然，这也是英国人渡过索姆河的同一天。

sentences.en: And it's agreed that if the English do manage to get across, then they will give battle and as many men as possible will be summoned.
sentences.zh: 双方一致认为，如果英国人真的设法过河，那么他们将进行战斗，并尽可能多地召集人马。

sentences.en: So they shouldn't rush into fighting the English immediately that they cross the river.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不应该在英国人一过河就急于与之交战。

sentences.en: They should try and get as many people as possible to make the odds absolutely overwhelming, but that they should definitely fight.
sentences.zh: 他们应该尽量召集尽可能多的人，使兵力对比呈现绝对压倒性的优势，但他们绝对应该打这一仗。

sentences.en: Now, what will be the role of the Dauphin or even more, you know, the king?
sentences.zh: 现在，太子甚至更进一步，国王的角色会是什么？

sentences.en: Because ideally you want someone from the royal family to lead this expedition.
sentences.zh: 因为理想情况下，你会希望王室成员来领导这次远征。

sentences.en: It's decided that the king obviously is in no state.
sentences.zh: 显然，人们一致认为国王目前的状态完全不适合参战。

sentences.en: He's made a glass.
sentences.zh: 他已经不省人事了。

sentences.en: Been mad to put him in a battle.
sentences.zh: 让他上战场简直是疯了。

sentences.en: You don't want him shattering.
sentences.zh: 你可不想让他支离破碎。

sentences.en: The Dauphin, as you say, is a bit podgy, but that's not actually the reason I think why he doesn't go.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，王太子有点胖，但这其实并不是我认为他没有去的原因。

sentences.en: It's because there are very vivid memories of Poitiers where the king got captured and that bled France dry.
sentences.zh: 原因是普瓦捷战役的惨痛记忆历历在目，当时国王被俘，这让法国元气大伤。

sentences.en: They don't want to risk any prospect of the king or the Dauphin being captured and then having to be ransomed.
sentences.zh: 他们不想冒任何国王或王太子被俘然后必须支付巨额赎金的风险。

sentences.en: But there's also a more immediate and vivid reason, which is that the vast proportion of people in this council of war are from the Armagnac faction.
sentences.zh: 但还有一个更直接、更生动的原因，那就是这个军事会议中的绝大多数人都是阿马尼亚克派的成员。

sentences.en: And so they are worried about John the Fearless because Henry is about to advance into Burgundian territory and they don't trust the Duke of Burgundy necessarily to be on their side.
sentences.zh: 因此他们对无畏的约翰感到担忧，因为亨利即将推进到勃艮第领地，而且他们不信任勃艮第公爵一定会站在他们这边。

sentences.en: And so the Dauphin will stay behind and he will be in command of troops that will essentially serve as a screen between Paris and the forces of the Duke of Burgundy.
sentences.zh: 所以王太子将留在后方，他将指挥的军队本质上将充当巴黎与勃艮第公爵军队之间的屏障。

sentences.en: As he's raising men, the people in this council of war are wondering, is it to attack the English or is it to attack Paris?
sentences.zh: 正当他在招兵买马时，这场军事会议上的人们在想，这是为了进攻英国人还是为了进攻巴黎？

sentences.en: So the Burgundians have raised an army, but they haven't joined with the Armagnacs and they're just sort of waiting.
sentences.zh: 所以勃艮第人组建了一支军队，但他们没有与阿马尼亚克派联合，只是在某种程度上观望。

sentences.en: Are they waiting to see who wins?
sentences.zh: 他们在等着看谁会赢吗？

sentences.en: So the shadow of the civil war between the Dukes of Orléans and Burgundy continues to be a massive problem for the French, even with Henry on their doorstep.
sentences.zh: 因此，奥尔良公爵与勃艮第公爵之间的内战阴影继续成为法国人的巨大难题，哪怕亨利已经兵临城下。

sentences.en: So because the king and the Dauphin are not going to be present with this army, it's important to have a member of the royal family.
sentences.zh: 所以，由于国王和王太子不会随这支军队出席，拥有一位王室成员至关重要。

sentences.en: And so the Duke of Orléans goes.
sentences.zh: 于是奥尔良公爵去了。

sentences.en: He's been preparing for his 21st birthday party.
sentences.zh: 他一直在筹备自己的21岁生日派对。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So he's due to be 21 on the 26th of October.
sentences.zh: 所以他本应在10月26日迎来21岁生日。

sentences.en: So he's obviously been kind of hanging around, getting ready, you know, hiring the disco and all that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 所以他显然一直在四处闲逛，做好准备，你知道的，雇迪斯科舞厅以及诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And then he gets to someone and says, no, you've got to come.
sentences.zh: 然后他找到某个人说，不，你必须来。

sentences.en: So he comes galloping up.
sentences.zh: 于是他骑着马飞奔而来。

sentences.en: But of course, his arrival means that there's no way the Duke of Burgundy is going to join them.
sentences.zh: 但当然，他的到来意味着勃艮第公爵绝不可能加入他们。

sentences.en: And actually, neither the Duke nor the Duke of Lorraine, who was mentioned by the Lieutenant of Calais, the reading that you gave at the beginning of this half.
sentences.zh: 事实上，加莱副指挥官——也就是你在前半部分开头发言时所读到的人——所提及的公爵，以及洛林公爵，都没有来。

sentences.en: And it's feared that he'll be coming with vast forces.
sentences.zh: 人们担心他会带着庞大的军队前来。

sentences.en: He doesn't arrive either because he's an ally of the Duke of Burgundy.
sentences.zh: 他也没有来，因为他是勃艮第公爵的盟友。

sentences.en: And nor does the Duke of Burgundy's son, the future Philip the Good, he doesn't arrive either.
sentences.zh: 勃艮第公爵的儿子、未来的好人菲利普也没有来。

sentences.en: And this will become a cause of great shame to both John the Fearless and to Philip the Good, the fact that they weren't at Agincourt.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们没有出席阿金库尔战役，这将成为无畏的约翰和好人菲利普日后巨大的耻辱。

sentences.en: And John the Fearless subsequently will explain this by saying that he had been forbidden by the king and by the royal council to come.
sentences.zh: 而无畏的约翰后来对此的解释是，他曾遭到国王和皇家委员会的禁止，不得前来。

sentences.en: I mean, it may be plausible.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这或许说得通。

sentences.en: And it's certainly the case that his two brothers, so the Duke of Brabant and the Count of Nevers, do ride to battle.
sentences.zh: 而且可以肯定的是，他的两个兄弟，即布拉班特公爵和讷韦尔伯爵确实骑马上了战场。

sentences.en: And lots of his kind of liegemen, his bannermen from Picardy, which is the region that Henry will be marching through, they do go as well.
sentences.zh: 他手下的许多部下，即来自皮卡第的旗队——也就是亨利将要行军穿过的地区——也确实去了。

sentences.en: So it's not like there are no one from the Burgundian side present at Agincourt.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是说阿金库尔没有一个勃艮第阵营的人出席。

sentences.en: But I think that John the Fearless is deliberately sitting it out.
sentences.zh: 但我认为无畏的约翰是故意坐壁上观。

sentences.en: Because obviously, if the Armagnacs get wiped out, you know, if maybe the Duke of Orlion will be killed in battle, you know, this would all be great for him.
sentences.zh: 因为很明显，如果阿马尼亚克派被彻底消灭，你知道的，如果奥尔良公爵在战斗中被杀，你知道的，这对他的发展大有裨益。

sentences.en: And he would then be in pole position to capitalise on it.
sentences.zh: 而他随后将处于最有利的位置来从中获利。

sentences.en: So I think that that's why he's not present.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这就是他没有出席的原因。

sentences.en: And of course, for a council of war that is dominated by the Armagnacs, I mean, this isn't bad news.
sentences.zh: 当然，对于一个由阿马尼亚克派主导的军事会议来说，这算不上坏消息。

sentences.en: They don't want him turning up because they don't want to share the glory of the victory.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望他出现，因为他们不想分享胜利的荣耀。

sentences.en: And they don't want the risk of him.
sentences.zh: 他们也不想承担与他有关的风险。

sentences.en: I mean, he might be in negotiations with Henry.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他可能正在与亨利进行谈判。

sentences.en: And they have enough men, right?
sentences.zh: 他们有足够的人手，对吧？

sentences.en: How many men do they have by this point?
sentences.zh: 他们到这个时候有多少人？

sentences.en: We will come to this in the next episode when we look at the actual battle, because it is a topic of more debate now than it has been for several centuries.
sentences.zh: 我们将在下一集中讨论这个问题，当我们审视实际的战斗时，因为与过去几个世纪相比，现在这是一个更具争议的话题。

sentences.en: But they definitely have more than Henry V.
sentences.zh: 但他们的人数绝对比亨利五世多。

sentences.en: They definitely have more.
sentences.zh: 他们的人数绝对更多。

sentences.en: And spoiler alert, I think they have substantially more.
sentences.zh: 剧透一下，我认为他们的人数要多得多。

sentences.en: But it is more of a live debate than it has been for a while, as I say.
sentences.zh: 但正如我所说，这比前一段时间更成了一个热门辩论话题。

sentences.en: So we're talking about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在讨论它。

sentences.en: But yeah, they have a large force.
sentences.zh: 但是的，他们拥有一支庞大的军队。

sentences.en: And so therefore, they are pretty confident of victory.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们对胜利相当有信心。

sentences.en: They have more than sufficient numbers to do the job.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有绰绰有余的人数来完成这项任务。

sentences.en: And so the day after this Council of War, the 20th of October, they send a herald to ride to Henry and to formally issue him with a challenge to battle.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个军事会议的第二天，即10月20日，他们派出一名先驱骑马去找亨利，正式向他下达战书。

sentences.en: So this is kind of very Arthurian.
sentences.zh: 所以这非常具有亚瑟王传奇的色彩。

sentences.en: This is chivalry and all that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是骑士精神以及诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And Henry, like the chivalrous knight that he is, he receives this herald very graciously.
sentences.zh: 而亨利就像他那样的骑士一样，非常亲切地接待了这位先驱。

sentences.en: And he sends a herald of his own back to the French.
sentences.zh: 并向法国人回派了他自己的一名先驱。

sentences.en: And the message that this herald delivers, it is not necessary to pick a day nor a place.
sentences.zh: 这位先驱传达的信息是，没有必要挑选日子或地点。

sentences.en: For every day, they could find him in the open fields without any difficulty.
sentences.zh: 因为每一天，他们都能毫无困难地在开阔的田野上找到他。

sentences.en: In other words, you know, if you want it, come and get it.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你知道的，如果你想要，就来拿吧。

sentences.en: You know where I am.
sentences.zh: 你知道我在哪里。

sentences.en: And so from this point on, he orders all his men to wear the coats of arms on their circuits if they're entitled to do this.
sentences.zh: 因此，从这一刻起，他命令他所有的手下，如果有资格的话，在他们的罩袍上佩戴纹章。

sentences.en: And this is a signal to the French that they are ready to fight.
sentences.zh: 这是向法国人发出他们准备战斗的信号。

sentences.en: They are ready for combat.
sentences.zh: 他们已经准备好战斗了。

sentences.en: But in the meanwhile, they continue their march towards Calais.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们继续向加莱行军。

sentences.en: The road is now direct.
sentences.zh: 道路现在是直的。

sentences.en: There are no real kind of impediments.
sentences.zh: 没有什么真正的阻碍。

sentences.en: And they do it expecting the French to attack them at any moment.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做的时候，预计法国人会随时攻击他们。

sentences.en: They are becoming increasingly nervous.
sentences.zh: 他们变得越来越紧张。

sentences.en: The surge of morale that had followed the crossing of the Somme is starting to subside.
sentences.zh: 渡过索姆河后带来的士气高涨开始消退。

sentences.en: And then their mood of anxiety is absolutely heightened by a time where they're going along
sentences.zh: 接着，当他们正沿着道路前进时，那种焦虑的情绪在一个时刻彻底高涨了

sentences.en: the road and suddenly they see ahead of them that the road has been completely churned up.
sentences.zh: 突然他们看到前方道路被彻底翻耕得面目全非。

sentences.en: They can see that a massive force has gone ahead of them.
sentences.zh: 他们能看出有一支庞大的军队走在了他们前面。

sentences.en: And they realize that this must be the French forces under D'Albray and Boussicot, the two great leaders of the French force, who are looking for a suitable place to offer battle.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到这一定是阿尔布雷埃和布西科率领的法国军队，这两位法军的伟大领袖正在寻找一个合适的地方发起战斗。

sentences.en: And so that at some point in the next day, maybe the day after that, they're going to find the French army drawn across the road to Calais.
sentences.zh: 这样在接下来的一天里的某个时刻，也许是随后的那一天，他们将发现法军排成阵势横亘在通往加莱的路上。

sentences.en: It's going to be impassable.
sentences.zh: 这将是无法通行的。

sentences.en: But for three days after that, they continue marching northwards.
sentences.zh: 但在那之后的整整三天里，他们继续向北行军。

sentences.en: The conditions are completely grim.
sentences.zh: 天气条件简直恶劣至极。

sentences.en: There's icy rain, gusting winds.
sentences.zh: 冰冷的雨水，阵阵狂风。

sentences.en: Their food supplies now are really, really low.
sentences.zh: 他们现在的食物储备真的非常非常少。

sentences.en: They're all feeling really, really hungry.
sentences.zh: 他们都感到非常非常饥饿。

sentences.en: And the terrain is becoming increasingly kind of hilly.
sentences.zh: 地形也变得越来越丘陵化。

sentences.en: They're having to go up and down, up and down.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不上下起伏，不断上坡下坡。

sentences.en: And a lot of them are ill, aren't they, at this point?
sentences.zh: 而且他们当中很多人在这个时候都生病了，对吧？

sentences.en: They have colds or dysentery or whatever, don't they?
sentences.zh: 他们得了感冒或痢疾什么的，对吧？

sentences.en: No, I don't think they're too ill.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为他们没有病得太厉害。

sentences.en: It's not like Harfleur.
sentences.zh: 这不像阿尔弗勒尔。

sentences.en: I mean, of course, you know, some are.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然，你知道的，有些人病了。

sentences.en: But no, I think they're despondent and wet and miserable and hungry.
sentences.zh: 但不，我认为他们只是沮丧、浑身湿透、痛苦不堪且饥肠辘辘。

sentences.en: But they're still kind of just about in a fit state to fight a battle.
sentences.zh: 但他们仍然勉强处于能够进行战斗的状态。

sentences.en: But their hope is, actually, you know, as the days pass and they still don't run into the French, maybe they'll do it.
sentences.zh: 但他们的希望其实是，你知道的，随着日子一天天过去，他们仍然没有撞见法国人，也许他们能成功。

sentences.en: So by the 24th of October, they're only about 40 miles from Calais.
sentences.zh: 所以在10月24日之前，他们距离加莱只有大约40英里。

sentences.en: I mean, they can almost feel that they're there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们几乎能感觉到自己已经到了。

sentences.en: And on the 24th of October, early morning, the English are descending into a river valley.
sentences.zh: 在10月24日清晨，英国人正在下坡进入一条河谷。

sentences.en: And ahead of them is a river called the Tournoise.
sentences.zh: 在他们前方是一条名为图尔努瓦的河流。

sentences.en: It's not a massive river, but, you know, but you don't want to be caught crossing it.
sentences.zh: 这不是一条大河，但是，你知道的，你可不想在渡河时被抓个正着。

sentences.en: So they're coming down towards the river when Henry's scouts come galloping up and they say,
sentences.zh: 正当他们朝着河边走去时，亨利的侦察兵飞奔过来并说道：

sentences.en: Your Majesty, alarming news.
sentences.zh: 陛下，有令人担忧的消息。

sentences.en: There are large numbers of French gathering in the road about three miles beyond the river.
sentences.zh: 河对岸大约三英里外的路上聚集了大量的法军。

sentences.en: And it looks like, you know, this is what we've been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来，你知道的，这就是我们一直在等待的。

sentences.en: They are massing there and they are ready to offer battle.
sentences.zh: 他们正在那里集结，准备发起战斗。

sentences.en: And for Henry, this is alarming news because he's got to get across this river.
sentences.zh: 对于亨利来说，这是一个令人担忧的消息，因为他必须过河。

sentences.en: You know, the ford may be held against him, even if it isn't.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，渡口可能会有人把守来阻击他，即使没有。

sentences.en: If the French attack him while he's crossing this river, you know, that would be not ideal.
sentences.zh: 如果法国人在他过河时袭击他，你知道的，那就太不理想了。

sentences.en: So he turns to his men and he says, Onwards, we've got to make full steam ahead.
sentences.zh: 于是他转向手下说道：前进，我们必须全速前进。

sentences.en: So they hurry down towards the river.
sentences.zh: 于是他们急忙向河边赶去。

sentences.en: Huge relief.
sentences.zh: 巨大的宽慰。

sentences.en: They find that the ford is not held against them.
sentences.zh: 他们发现渡口并没有人把守来阻击他们。

sentences.en: They cross the river at top speed and then they march up the hill again towards the crest of the next ridge.
sentences.zh: 他们以最快的速度渡过河，然后再次爬上山坡，朝下一个山脊的顶端行进。

sentences.en: And they reach the crest of the hill and at the top of the hill, they gaze at the vista that they see before them.
sentences.zh: 他们到达了山顶，在山顶上，他们凝视着展现在眼前的景色。

sentences.en: And the sight is a terrifying one.
sentences.zh: 而这景象令人毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: And I quote, About half a mile away, the grim looking ranks of the French.
sentences.zh: 我引用原话：大约半英里外，法军面目狰狞的阵列。

sentences.en: And these ranks are being added to all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且这些阵列还在不断增加。

sentences.en: As they stand there on the ridge, the English can see ever more squadrons of French marching in, riding in, swelling the numbers of the army that is blocking the road to Calais.
sentences.zh: 当他们站在山脊上时，英国人看到越来越多的法军中队开进来、骑马赶来，不断壮大着那支阻断通往加莱道路的军队。

sentences.en: And Henry asks his spies, These two villages ahead of us, I can see that the French are kind of massing there around them.
sentences.zh: 亨利问他的密探：我们前方这两个村庄，我能看到法军正成群结队地在那里周围集结。

sentences.en: What are the names of these villages?
sentences.zh: 这些村庄叫什么名字？

sentences.en: And he is told, Well, one of them is called Risseauville.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉他：嗯，其中一个叫里索维尔。

sentences.en: And the other, Your Majesty, the name of this village, it is Agincourt.
sentences.zh: 另一个，陛下，这个村庄的名字叫阿金库尔。

sentences.en: Well, if you want to hear what happens next right away, then you can join the Rest is History Club at therestishistory.com.
sentences.zh: 如果你想立刻听到接下来发生的事情，你可以加入历史其余部分俱乐部的网站 therestishistory.com。

sentences.en: But either way, we will be back with the Battle of Agincourt.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，我们都将带着阿金库尔战役归来。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
